title: 第020章 功成归宗受嘉赏，音律古阁引灵鸣
content_zh:
辞别一众淳朴的村民。

    蔡文姬与王磊转身踏上返回清风宗的山路。

    晚风拂过山林，枝叶沙沙作响。

    一路行来，蔡文姬心境愈发澄澈通透。

    旁人修仙，追名逐利、争强好胜。

    被境界、资源、战力裹挟前行。

    而她以琴音为道，以慈悲为本，护佑弱小，惩治奸邪。

    每一步都走得心安理得。

    王磊走在身侧，时刻留意着她的状态，时不时伸手扶她一把。

    看着天边的晚霞，轻声感慨道：

    “这次下山真是太值了！不仅肃清了七个村的祸患。还见识到了师妹你的真本事。”

    “只是……你付出的代价也太大了。”他顿了顿，语气满是愧疚。

    “都怪我没用，只能帮你打打下手。让你一个人扛下所有最危险的净化。”

    蔡文姬唇角扬起一抹浅浅的笑意：

    “王师兄客气了。若不是你一路护我周全，处理杂务。”

    “我也不能专心施法救人。对付魔渊浊气本就是我的专长。”

    梦奇趴在她的肩头，抱着蜂蜜罐风卷残云，舔得正香，含糊不清地接话：“还有我呦！我也……帮文姬吃了好多坏气气呢！”

    两人一兽一路说说笑笑。

    不到一个时辰，便登上了青螺山山门。

    刚踏入山门。

    就见外门管事周管事带着几名弟子，早已在广场上等候多时。

    看到两人安然归来，尤其是看到蔡文姬苍白的脸色。

    周管事脸上的笑容立刻收敛，快步迎了上来。

    “你们可算回来了！山下各村的事情，我们都听说了！”

    “你们二人肃清邪修、拔除毒瘴、治愈数千病患。”

    “安一方百姓，扬我清风宗正道威名，做得极好！”

    王磊连忙上前拱手行礼，恭敬地汇报道：

    “回禀管事，此次任务圆满完成。落云村三名散修已罚其劳作赎罪。”

    “清溪村的蚀骨毒瘴与魔渊浊气已彻底净化。”

    “周边其余五个村落的零散邪祟也一并清理干净。”

    “此次能顺利完成任务，全靠蔡师妹力挽狂澜。”

    “弟子只是打打下手，帮着看管恶人、维持秩序罢了。”

    “再就是……”

    他心胸宽广，一向不屑于抢功那等腌臜事，真心将所有功劳都推给了蔡文姬。

    也如实说了自己做的琐事。

    更特意提到了蔡文姬为救百姓，多次遭受魔渊浊气反噬的事情。

    还有梦奇帮忙吞噬毒瘴、安抚村民的功劳。
content_en:
Farewell to all the simple villagers.

    Cai Wenji and Wang Lei turned around and embarked on the mountain road back to Qingfeng Sect.

    The evening breeze blew through the forest, making the branches and leaves rustle.

    Along the way, Cai Wenji's state of mind became clearer and clearer.

    Others are cultivating immortality, pursuing fame and wealth, and being competitive.

    Move forward by being driven by realm, resources, and combat power.

    And she takes the sound of the piano as her way and her compassion as her foundation, protecting the weak and punishing the evil.

    Every step was taken with peace of mind.

    Wang Lei walked beside her, always paying attention to her condition, and reaching out to help her from time to time.

    Looking at the sunset on the horizon, he sighed softly:

    "This trip down the mountain was really worth it! Not only did we eliminate the troubles in seven villages. I also saw your true abilities, junior sister."

    "It's just... the price you paid is too high." He paused, his tone full of guilt.

    "It's all because I'm useless. I can only help you. Let you carry out all the most dangerous purifications alone."

    A faint smile appeared on Cai Wenji's lips:

    "Senior Brother Wang, you're too polite. If you hadn't protected me all the way and handled the chores."

    "I can't concentrate on casting spells to save people. Dealing with the turbid energy of the devil's abyss is my specialty."

    Meng Qi lay on her shoulder, holding the honey jar, licking it sweetly, and answered vaguely: "And me! I also... helped Wen Ji eat a lot of bad things!"

    The two of them talked and laughed all the way.

    In less than an hour, they reached the gate of Qingluo Mountain.

    Just stepped into the mountain gate.

    I saw the outer gate manager Zhou Guanshi and several disciples, who had been waiting in the square for a long time.

    Seeing the two of them returning safely, especially Cai Wenji's pale face.

    The smile on Manager Zhou's face immediately faded and he quickly came forward to greet him.

    "You are finally back! We have heard about what happened in the villages down the mountain!"

    "The two of you eliminated evil practices, eradicated poisonous diseases, and cured thousands of patients."

    "It's a great job to bring peace to the people and promote the reputation of our Qingfeng Sect's righteous way!"

    Wang Lei quickly stepped forward, bowed his hands, and respectfully reported:

    "Reporting to the steward, this mission has been successfully completed. The three casual cultivators in Luoyun Village have been punished with hard work to atone for their sins."

    "The bone-eroding poisonous miasma and demonic abyss turbidity in Qingxi Village have been completely purified."

    "The scattered evil spirits in the other five surrounding villages have also been cleaned up."

    "The successful completion of the mission this time is all thanks to Junior Sister Cai's efforts to turn the tide."

    "The disciples are just here to help guard the evildoers and maintain order."

    "And then..."

    He is broad-minded and has always disdainful things like grabbing credit, and sincerely gives all the credit to Cai Wenji.

    He also told the truth about the trivial things he did.

    He also specifically mentioned that Cai Wenji suffered multiple backlashes from the demonic abyss in order to save the people.

    There is also Mengqi’s contribution in helping to swallow the poisonous miasma and appease the villagers.
title_en: Chapter 020 Returning to the sect for success and being rewarded, the ancient music pavilion arouses the sound of souls
